doRules: Open on the most surprising concrete moment of the story in 10 words or fewer.
Give the story a full arc: setup, complication, a mid-point reversal, the turn, then the payoff.
Hold the answer to the hook's question until the final 20% of the narration.
Make every sentence something that can be shown on screen: a person doing something somewhere.
End with a line that flows naturally back into the first line of the hook.
dontRules: Never open with a greeting, 'Did you know', 'Today we', or 'A user on Reddit posted'.
Never read or closely paraphrase the source text; retell it in fresh words.
Never invent facts for true stories, and never ask viewers to like or subscribe.
Avoid sentences longer than 16 words, passive voice, and abstract commentary.
